policy_summary: Use contradiction only when the negated local subclaim has a carrier and an accepted conflict target.
Use impossibility theorem formation only for scoped method classes with explicit parameters and escape conditions.
Keep constructive exploration alive when beta=0, subpolynomial queries, nonblackbox use, non-naturalness, or advice-free certificates remain untested.
Treat scoped no-go results and finite falsifiers as possible paper-level stepping stones.
purpose: Route-specific selection of contradiction, impossibility, falsifier, and constructive tactics for P vs NP discovery branches.

recommendations.conflict_target: claimed all-exponent exclusion for NP not subset P/poly despite positive beta
recommendations.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: the transfer inequality SAT in SIZE(n^c) => source carrier in SIZE(N^{q+beta c+o(1)})
escape_conditions: beta=0 or genuinely subpolynomial target-query length
a nonblackbox use of the SAT circuit not summarized by query exponent beta
a source lower bound stronger than the transferred upper-bound window
recommendations.exact_negation_or_method_class: black-box target-circuit substitution interfaces with source size N, target query length n^beta, and overhead N^q
recommendations.next_validation_handoff: Send this packet to pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor for exact parameters, then to pvsnp-impossibility-theorem-forger and contradiction-route-auditor if the obstruction is theorem-shaped.
recommendations.paper_contribution_potential: Potential paper-level stepping stone if the result becomes a scoped theorem or finite falsifier with prior-art boundary and explicit escape conditions.
recommendations.prompt_guidance: Use tactic_mode=falsifier_search for route_family=black_box_substitution_or_hardness_magnification. Do not restate barriers; produce the local carrier, exact transfer or contradiction target, escape conditions, and validation handoff.
proof_obligations: Compute beta and q for the named carrier, including all padding and decoding overhead.

recommendations.reason_for_tactic: The decisive issue is whether positive target-query exponent beta and overhead q cap the transfer before it reaches all SAT exponents.
